images.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create a brand-new high-resolution editorial fashion photograph, NOT an enlargement of an existing image. Luxury monochrome fashion story, black and ivory clothing, natural skin texture, softly diffused light, realistic fabric detail, restrained contrast, neutral backgrounds. Portrait 2:3 composition suitable for an oval crop, subject fully inside frame with a little margin. No typography, watermark, logos, UI, border, or oval mask. An adult female atelier designer with dark hair in a neat low bun, wearing an oversized ivory white cotton shirt, seen in profile facing left, thoughtfully handling a black garment on a dress form. Three-quarter portrait from head to upper thigh. Bright white fashion studio background with out-of-focus paper patterns. Her upper body and face visible, hands at waist height. Match the candid quiet mood of a fashion design studio.
